training.early_stop: same model objective on predesignated inner-stop maps only
training.normalization: fit scenes only; balanced scene then origin then candidate
training.sample_unit: one actual branch at the matched origin; no new sliding-window density
training.near_ties: abs real total discounted-return difference <=1.0; excluded only from binary rank loss, retained for difference regression; fixed before new labels

collection: Candidates generated BEFORE observing any suffix rewards: original Q Gaussian/AR(1) MPPI baseline, first fixed Gaussian in iteration0, weighted final mean, actual global elite after common cached Q rescore. 64/8/4 and all cfg noise/std/rho unchanged. Native H=10 prefix then unchanged frozen SAC to native done. Same-origin RNG/config/observed state/candidates must match across fresh-process branches. No selection by actual return; unreachable origins explicitly retained.
isolation: New 12fit+4stop+6fresh validation maps predeclared. Old 8fit/4stop reused in their original roles only. Previous6 validation and old20/official tests never used in training, selection or fresh validation. Single validation pass after all five models and epochs freeze. No larger closed-loop unless independently qualified.
implementation_notes: Full grouped batch: fewer than200 fit candidates; exact same scene-origin weights instead of minibatch noise. This implementation choice is fixed before fitting or validation.
Validation collection runs separately with labels unread by fitting/epoch-selection code. Analysis begins only after all five models are saved.
Final gate compares paired regret against both original Q and previous V_SAC. Primary input C fixed, never chosen from validation winners.
